description: Check a domain's mail authentication: SPF, DMARC (from a parent domain when the domain has no record of its own), DKIM, MX and MTA-STS, each check with pass, warn or fail and a severity.

dkim_selector.description: DKIM selector, such as google; without it the check tries the selectors of the domain's mail providers
